description: This file is the entry point for a React application, setting up the React root and rendering the main App component within StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application, targeting the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React component tree inside the created root, starting with React.StrictMode and the App component.
